purpose: Complete all candidate scene residuals on the already fixed 12-source/20-video/697-frame exploratory FIT population, then compare residual cues against raw appearance on a common supported known-label readout.
candidate_contract: All retained query rows x all retained immediately previous rows for every adjacent selected pair; no identity/category/outcome filtering; unknown endpoints retained.
residual_contract: Strict endpoint exclusion, fresh reciprocal matching, minimum 3 anchors, componentwise median translation in original-image pixels, normalized residual L1 and gain; unavailable is explicit.
readout: After GT-free seal, use previously sealed eligible FIT labels only for source-macro AUC and common supported-query repair/break; unknown is not negative.
interpretation: Exploratory information gate only; no learned fusion, tracker metric, independent generalization, physical camera interpretation, or novelty claim.
